brief:
A modeling reference sheet (turnaround) for ONE low-poly 3D game asset: an inflatable striped beach ball.

Canvas and layout, keep exactly:
- 1536 x 1024 landscape image, a 2 x 2 grid of four equal panels.
- Top-left panel: FRONT view. Top-right: RIGHT side view. Bottom-left: BACK view. Bottom-right: TOP view (looking straight down).
- Orthographic cameras (no perspective), the same scale in every panel, the object centred in each panel and standing on the same invisible ground line in the three side views.
- Each side view is exactly frontal to its side: no other face of the object shows in it (a slightly oblique view comes out wider and fails the aspect gate).
- The four panels show the SAME object, only turned: FRONT: the object faces the camera. RIGHT: the camera has walked round to the object's own right-hand side (not the image's right), so the object faces the LEFT edge of the image. BACK: seen from behind. TOP: seen from straight above, looking down, with its front towards the BOTTOM edge of the image and no wall showing. Each detail appears only in the views from which it is really visible (a part seen side-on in one view is seen end-on in another).
- One flat, uniform background (#9a9a9a) everywhere: no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no frame lines, no text, no labels.

The object (identical in all four views):
- A faceted low-poly ball 0.8 m across, resting on the ground, its axis vertical.
- Six wide panels (gores) running from the top pole to the bottom pole like orange segments. Going round the ball counter-clockwise seen from above, starting at the panel that faces the FRONT: red #d41e3c, blue #488bd4, yellow #ffb84a, white #faffff, green #28c074, white #faffff.
- What each panel shows (the same ball, only turned): FRONT panel: the red gore in the centre, the blue gore to the image's right of it, a white gore to the image's left. RIGHT panel: the edge between the blue gore (image left half) and the yellow gore (image right half) runs down the middle; a sliver of red at the far left edge, a sliver of white at the far right edge. BACK panel: the white gore that is opposite the red one in the centre, the yellow gore to the image's left of it, the green gore to the image's right. TOP panel: the red gore pointing to the BOTTOM edge of the image, then going counter-clockwise: blue to the lower right, yellow to the upper right, white at the top, green to the upper left, white to the lower left.
- A round white #faffff cap at the top pole and one at the bottom pole, each 0.25 m across.
- Seen from the TOP: the white cap in the centre with the six coloured panels radiating out like a pie, in the order above.

Style, keep exactly:
- A clean low-poly 3D model render: faceted, flat-shaded faces, hard straight edges, about 12 segments around and 8 rings, about 200 triangles worth of detail. No smooth surfaces, no shine, no valve, no logo, no texture noise, no grain.
- Flat colour areas only, ONLY these colours (from the Journey palette): #d41e3c #faffff #ffb84a #488bd4 #28c074.
- Soft, even light from the upper left, so each face reads as one flat tone; no specular highlights, no ambient occlusion blur.
